title: Db2 13 for z/OS function levels and APPLCOMPAT gates that affect DDL
authority: Official IBM Db2 13 for z/OS documentation only: the function-level pages, the V12R1Mnnn/V13R1Mnnn APPLCOMPAT tables, the APPLCOMPAT incompatibility list, the Db2 13 incompatible-changes list and the Db2 13 deprecation list. Capability titles are IBM's; DDL notes are summaries with source IDs.
how_gates_work: A function level (FL) activates capabilities subsystem-wide. Activating a level also activates every lower level.

Most new SQL syntax and behavior also needs an equal or higher application compatibility (APPLCOMPAT) level for the package that runs the statement; otherwise Db2 returns an error such as SQLCODE -4743 or keeps the previous behavior.

APPLCOMPAT cannot exceed the highest activated function level. Db2 13 still accepts lower APPLCOMPAT values (V10R1, V11R1, V12R1M100-M510, V13R1Mnnn), and some DDL defaults change across those levels.
Record the activated FL, the catalog level, and the APPLCOMPAT of the package that runs the DDL (for example SPUFI or DSNTEP2) in the environment profile.

levels.label: FL 100
capabilities: Index look-aside optimization
Sort optimization
Expanded SORTL usage with learning from execution (IBM z15)
Improved locking and cross-partition search for INSERT to PBG table spaces
Reduced ECSA storage for IFI buffers
Column names longer than 30 bytes
Relative page numbering for new PBR table spaces (PAGESET_PAGENUM default RELATIVE)
Improved default statistics collection granularity
Enhanced space-level recovery with the RECOVER utility

ddl_notes.summary: Column names can be up to 128 bytes when the TABLE_COL_NAME_EXPANSION subsystem parameter is ON (the limits page spells it TABLE_COLUMN_NAME_EXPANSION); otherwise 30 bytes. Names over 30 bytes can be truncated in SQLDA-based APIs.
The PAGESET_PAGENUM default changed to RELATIVE, so an omitted PAGENUM on a new PBR table space uses relative page numbering unless the installation overrides it.
A KEY LABEL on CREATE/ALTER STOGROUP or CREATE/ALTER TABLE cannot name an ICSF key archived for decryption only.

levels.label: FL 500
capabilities: Increased flexibility for package ownership
Page sampling for inline statistics
SQL Data Insights
Reduced ECSA storage for IFI buffers
Online conversion of tables from growth-based (PBG) to range-based (PBR) partitions
Fast index traversal (FTB) support for larger index keys
Increased control for applications over how long to wait for a lock
Profile table enhancements for application environment settings
Ability to delete an active log data set from the BSDS while Db2 is running
SPT01 and SYSLGRNX table spaces are converted to DSSIZE 256 GB
Improved concurrency for altering tables for DATA CAPTURE
Change REORG INDEX SHRLEVEL REFERENCE or CHANGE so the NOSYSUT1 keyword is the default
CREATE TABLESPACE uses MAXPARTITIONS 254 by default
Long names support for timeout and deadlock messages in IRLM

ddl_notes.summary: At APPLCOMPAT V13R1M500 or higher an omitted MAXPARTITIONS gives 254 (previously 256 from V12R1M504); the calculated default DSSIZE is 4 G. IBM lists this as an incompatible change.
CREATE/ALTER PROCEDURE (SQL native) and CREATE/ALTER FUNCTION (compiled SQL scalar) accept AS ROLE or AS USER on PACKAGE OWNER at APPLCOMPAT V13R1M500.
ALTER TABLE ... ALTER PARTITIONING TO PARTITION BY RANGE converts PBG to PBR (pending change, materialized by REORG; result uses relative page numbering).
CURRENT LOCK TIMEOUT special register and SET CURRENT LOCK TIMEOUT statement.

levels.label: FL 501
capabilities: Allow applications to specify a deadlock resolution priority
DEADLOCK_RESOLUTION_PRIORITY global variable
Real-time statistics scalability
Collection of real-time and historical information about utility execution
Real-time statistics support for index splits

ddl_notes.summary: SYSIBMADM.DEADLOCK_RESOLUTION_PRIORITY built-in global variable (APPLCOMPAT V13R1M501). No CREATE-statement syntax changes.

levels.label: FL 502
capabilities: Db2 controlled sysplex workload balancing (PH48253)
Record dependencies and validity at the statement level for packages (PH47560)

ddl_notes.summary: DEPLEVEL(STATEMENT) bind option; SYSPACKAGE.VALID can be 'S'. Affects routine/trigger package verification queries, not CREATE syntax.

levels.label: FL 503
capabilities: New default values in existing rows for added ROW CHANGE TIMESTAMP columns (PH51185)
Accelerator-only support for more than 32K elements in an IN list (PH50756)
SELECT INTO statement support for OPTIMIZE FOR n ROWS (PH50010)

ddl_notes.summary: At APPLCOMPAT V13R1M503, ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN for a ROW CHANGE TIMESTAMP column sets SYSCOLUMNS.DEFAULTVALUE to the ALTER timestamp (incompatible change). CREATE TABLE does not set DEFAULTVALUE.

levels.label: FL 504
capabilities: Minimized impact of invalidated packages with statement-level invalidation (PH55497)
Db2 trace capacity: More OP buffers (PH55622)
Utility object-level history (PH55476, PH55914, PH55915, PH55916)
Enhancements to SQL Data Insights (PH55212)
ORDER BY support for a fullselect that invokes LISTAGG (PH55596)

ddl_notes.summary: A fullselect that invokes LISTAGG can specify ORDER BY at APPLCOMPAT V13R1M504 (relevant to view and MQT definitions).

levels.label: FL 505
capabilities: New token-based authentication capability (PH55599)
Temporal support for security-related catalog tables (PH59531)
New trace destination for Db2ZAI (PH56369)
INTERPRET scalar function (PH59595)

ddl_notes.summary: INTERPRET built-in function (APPLCOMPAT V13R1M505). No CREATE-statement syntax changes.

levels.label: FL 506
capabilities: Non-disruptive clearing of data partitions with LOAD (PH62543)
Improved performance for IN-list predicates (PH58750)
Db2 trace capacity: More concurrently active traces (PH59020)
INSERT with multi-row VALUES clause (PH62561)
Add implicitly hidden ROWID columns (PH61629)
Lift certain restrictions for column masks (PH62393, PH62690)

ddl_notes.summary: ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN can define an IMPLICITLY HIDDEN ROWID column in a UTS table at APPLCOMPAT V13R1M506 (one per table); lower levels return SQLCODE -270.
INSERT ... VALUES (...), (...) with multiple rows at APPLCOMPAT V13R1M506 (seed data in QA scripts).

levels.label: FL 507
capabilities: Online conversion of table partitioning from PBR to PBG (PH64949, PH64950)
Enhanced application availability for system temporal tables (PH65039)
LASTUSED column support in the SYSIBM.SYSPLAN catalog table (PH64762)
Referencing temporal and archive-enabled tables in the same SELECT statement (PH65133)
Specify greater than 64 GB primary and secondary space allocation quantities (PH64760)

ddl_notes.summary: ALTER TABLE ... ALTER PARTITIONING TO PARTITION BY GROWTH at APPLCOMPAT V13R1M507; can be stacked with PBG-to-PBR conversion in one REORG.

CREATE/ALTER TABLESPACE and CREATE LOB TABLESPACE accept PRIQTY up to 1 TB (1073741824 KB) and SECQTY up to 200 GB (209715200 KB) at APPLCOMPAT V13R1M507. Larger values are reduced to those caps; below this level the cap is 64 GB.
SYSTIME_PERIOD_ADJUST built-in global variable for system-period temporal tables (APPLCOMPAT V13R1M507).

levels.label: FL 508
capabilities: BLOCKING_THREADS table function enhancements (PH67082)
Increasing the maximum number of active and archive logs (PH67380)
Specify sort work or DGTT usage for PBG table spaces in the work file database (PH67418)
Generation of UUID values (PH67353)
More local applications control with Db2 profile tables (PH67138)
Consistent DSSIZE records in Db2 catalog tables for UTS and LOB objects (PH67419)
Rebind phase-in for SQL PL and trigger packages (PH67404)
Preparation for conversion of non-UTS catalog and directory objects (PH67554)

ddl_notes.summary: CREATE TABLESPACE ... FOR SORT | FOR DGTT for PBG table spaces in a work file database at APPLCOMPAT V13R1M508 (ALTER TABLESPACE support needs PH71332). SYSTABLESPACE.USAGE records it.
GENERATE_UUID, GENERATE_UUID_BINARY, VARBINARY_FORMAT and VARCHAR_FORMAT_BINARY built-in functions at APPLCOMPAT V13R1M508; the UUID generators need IBM z14 or later.

From catalog level V13R1M508, DSSIZE columns in SYSINDEXES/SYSINDEXPART are BIGINT and DSSIZE/PIECESIZE are populated consistently for UTS and LOB objects. Catalog queries that select SYSINDEXES.DSSIZE need catalog level V13R1M508.

levels.label: FL 509
capabilities: Converting Db2 catalog table spaces to UTS (PH70027)
Subnet wildcard filtering for resource limit facility (RLF) (PH70071)
Online ownership transfer of application objects (PH69677)
Utility history for SHRLEVEL information (PH70075)
New catalog columns for STMT_HASHID2 (PH70030)
I/O counts in real time statistics (PH70074)
Reduced false page P-lock contention in data sharing (PH69217)

ddl_notes.summary: TRANSFER OWNERSHIP accepts function-designator, PROCEDURE and SEQUENCE at APPLCOMPAT V13R1M509.
Page sets created after FL 509 with DSSIZE above 64 GB (4 KB pages) or 128 GB (8 KB pages) use a new lock hash algorithm; behavioral, not syntax.

announced_levels.evidence: The V13R1Mnnn APPLCOMPAT table lists CREATE TRIGGER (basic) REFERENCING UNIT_OF_RECOVERY_ID AS ur-identifier at V13R1M510. No function level 510 page was published on the review date.

The Db2 13 deprecation table lists V13R1M511 as the level at which synonyms, hash-organized tables, non-UTS table spaces for base tables, index-controlled partitioning, basic row format, 6-byte RBA/LRSN page sets and SNA/VTAM can no longer be created or accessed.

applcompat_gates.syntax: CREATE TABLESPACE PAGENUM and INSERT ALGORITHM; CREATE TABLE PAGENUM, column CCSID on CHAR/GRAPHIC/CLOB/DBCLOB, PERIOD BUSINESS_TIME EXCLUSIVE/INCLUSIVE, PERIOD BUSINESS_TIME in constraints; CREATE INDEX DSSIZE; advanced triggers; WRAPPED; CONCENTRATE STATEMENTS. CREATE TABLESPACE/INDEX without USING fail with -204 if the database storage group does not exist.
ON DELETE ADD EXTRA ROW (system-period temporal versioning)
Base table spaces are always PBG or PBR; synonyms and hash-organized tables cannot be created; one table per UTS; CREATE AUX TABLE needs PART when the base table is in a PBG table space.
DECFLOAT columns in PRIMARY KEY, UNIQUE and index keys

DROP TABLE for a table in an explicitly created UTS implicitly drops the table space; dropping an auxiliary table drops its explicit LOB table space. Below this level DROP TABLE of a PBG table fails with SQLCODE -669.
COMPRESS YES FIXEDLENGTH | COMPRESS YES HUFFMAN
ALTER PARTITIONING TO PARTITION BY RANGE
PACKAGE OWNER ... AS ROLE | AS USER
ALTER PARTITIONING TO PARTITION BY GROWTH
PRIQTY above 64 GB up to 1 TB; SECQTY above 64 GB up to 200 GB

applcompat_gates.note: Listed in the APPLCOMPAT table; no FL 510 page existed on the review date.

behavior_changes.summary: Omitted MAXPARTITIONS on CREATE TABLESPACE: 254 at V13R1M500 or higher; 256 (with default DSSIZE 4 G) at V12R1M504 through V13R1M100.
Statements that create base table spaces always create PBG or PBR; non-UTS, synonyms and hash organization return errors.
DROP TABLE in an explicit UTS also drops the table space; DROP of an auxiliary table also drops its explicit LOB table space.
ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN for ROW CHANGE TIMESTAMP records the ALTER timestamp in SYSCOLUMNS.DEFAULTVALUE.
DISPLAY DATABASE can return WF, WD or WS instead of TS for work file table spaces.

deprecations.feature: Absolute page numbering for PBR table spaces
deprecations.alternative: PBR with relative page numbering (PAGENUM RELATIVE)
ALTER TABLE ... DROP ORGANIZATION and fast index traversal
deprecations.removal: Cannot be created at APPLCOMPAT V12R1M504+; cannot be created or accessed at V13R1M511

deprecations.feature: Non-UTS table spaces for base tables (segmented, partitioned, simple) and index-controlled partitioning
deprecations.removal: Cannot be created at APPLCOMPAT V12R1M504+; cannot be created or accessed at V13R1M511
Cannot be created at APPLCOMPAT V12R1M504+; cannot be created or accessed at V13R1M511

deprecations.feature: Page sets with basic 6-byte RBA or LRSN
